implementation_rule: Calculate all NPC and annualised costs in real terms
notes: Do not mix with nominal escalation

implementation_rule: Apply component-specific replacement and salvage within horizon
Only apply when O&M is modelled as rising faster than general inflation
Optional policy scenario; base case remains zero unless paper scope explicitly includes carbon pricing
Base case uses unrecovered-life fraction of replacement cost
Apply only to technologies whose source estimate assumes metropolitan/coastal conditions
notes: Avoid applying twice when a source already contains regional logistics; mandatory sensitivity test
